name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.153.0 — /spec:run now opens the spec's own git worktree by default, before anything else runs — --in-place is the deliberate opt-out, and a worktree that cannot be created is a hard stop, never a silent continuation in place. The design, build, and review stages are no longer separate slash commands: their bodies moved under spec/doctrine/stages/ as prose /spec:run alone executes, and the state-machine hook now gates only /spec:plan and /spec:run. The ledger still records via for the fleet's escapes-per-CLEAN query. 7.152.0 — The client exclusions card now explains itself: a heading counts the rows, a lead poses the question and warns that an unanswered row is recorded as not contested when the work is signed off, and each row constructed from the client's own words (an answer or a withdrawn request) quotes them beside the paraphrase, naming the screen they came from. Every answered row — agreed, needed, or dropped by a retired source — renders a state sentence instead of buttons, held by data-verdict, and the in-session render after pressing a button matches the reload render exactly. 7.151.0 — Tests expire at close: a spec's tagged tests are deleted at review close unless they cite a ledger escape class, exercise a script the pipeline itself runs, or pin an opt-in SHALL CONTINUE TO criterion dated on or after 20260911. An AC-ID defined by more than one spec counts as done only when every spec defining it is done, so a number collision can never delete an unfinished spec's tests. The review row records tests:{born,kept,retired} and the close commit carries the deletions; /spec:doctor gains check 20 to run the same rule as a dry run across every done spec in a host, applying only after one question naming the count and the files.
